commands.command:
set -eu
MAC=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
WT=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
PI=michal@192.168.0.23
KEY=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
CODE_SHA=fbeefb174c309a252e82b47b20dbe3bf63217485
DOC_SHA=d21400207c121eb3169647978072ee18a99269d1
FIX_SHA=524c40a218ad59d985a133efc542e99f51f5912a
BRANCH=fix/macbook-trackpad-zoom
test -r "$KEY"
cd "$MAC"
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = agent-work
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$DOC_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$FIX_SHA" "$DOC_SHA"
printf 'DOC_ONLY_COMMIT_FILES\n'
git diff --name-only "$CODE_SHA" "$DOC_SHA"
git diff --name-only "$CODE_SHA" "$DOC_SHA" | while IFS= read -r file; do
 case "$file" in README.md|docs/checkpoints/2026-10-31-macbook-trackpad-zoom-deploy.md|docs/deploy-pi-zero2w.md|docs/dev.md|frontend/src/components/map/AGENTS.md) ;; *) echo "UNEXPECTED_POST_DEPLOY_CODE_CHANGE=$file"; exit 3 ;; esac
done
SSH="ssh -i $KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10"
$SSH "$PI" bash -s -- "$CODE_SHA" "$DOC_SHA" <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
CODE_SHA="$1"; DOC_SHA="$2"
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CODE_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
BEFORE_PID="$(pgrep -f "[p]ython[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]].*/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/server\\.py([[:space:]]|$)" | head -n 1)"
test -n "$BEFORE_PID"
git fetch --no-tags origin main
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$DOC_SHA"
git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$DOC_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
AFTER_PID="$(pgrep -f "[p]ython[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]].*/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/server\\.py([[:space:]]|$)" | head -n 1)"
test "$BEFORE_PID" = "$AFTER_PID"
printf 'PI_RUNTIME_PID_UNCHANGED=%s\n' "$AFTER_PID"
printf 'PI_FINAL_MAIN=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'PI_FINAL_HEALTH='
curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
printf '\n'
printf 'PI_FINAL_FRONTEND_HTTP='
curl -fsS --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/
printf 'PI_FINAL_MAP_HTTP='
curl -fsS --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map
test -f .dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre/app-before.sqlite
test -f .dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre/frontend/index.html
test ! -e .dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre/frontend-next
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = d654499fcacc770517afd462bd0c3902147033e45a999655f4c8b88ab26e10cf
printf 'PROD_BACKUP_PRESERVED=yes\n'
make server-status
make tunnel-status
REMOTE
printf 'MAC_WORKTREE_CLEANUP_PREFLIGHT\n'
test -d "$WT"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$FIX_SHA"
test "$(git -C "$WT" branch --show-current)" = "$BRANCH"
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain=v1)"
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" ls-files --others --exclude-standard)"
for protected in .env .cloudflared backups research-exports; do
 test ! -e "$WT/$protected" || { echo "WORKTREE_HAS_PROTECTED_UNTRACKED=$protected"; exit 4; }
done
test -f "$WT/backend/data/app.db"
WT="$WT" "$WT/backend/.venv/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import os,sqlite3
db=sqlite3.connect("file:"+os.environ["WT"]+"/backend/data/app.db?mode=ro",uri=True)
places=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place").fetchone()[0]
photos=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo").fetchone()[0]
print("WORKTREE_SYNTHETIC_PLACE_COUNT",places)
print("WORKTREE_SYNTHETIC_PHOTO_COUNT",photos)
assert places==120 and photos==120, "refuse to erase unexpected worktree data"
PY
printf 'WORKTREE_REMOVING_DISPOSABLE_FIXTURES\n'
git worktree remove --force "$WT"
git worktree prune
git branch -d "$BRANCH"
git push origin --delete "$BRANCH"
git fetch --no-tags --prune origin
printf 'FINAL_MAC_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'FINAL_MAC_SHA=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'FINAL_MAC_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
test ! -e "$WT"
echo PHOTOMAP_ZOOM_DOCS_SYNC_AND_CLEANUP_PASS
